text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
choice_data_list: You're looking a little under the weather.
You're looking a little under the weather.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I have a bit of a headache… It's been raining a lot lately, so it may have something to do with the air pressure…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: …No, I can't be weak! I'll break that jinx and cheer right—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: R-right… Ugh. Is there no way to get ahead of nature?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nnng… I'm sorry, but I might go lie down for a bit…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She doesn't like rain to begin with, so I'm sure the weather is only making her headache worse. Hopefully it clears up soon…
